issues.jp_before: 山田[やまだ]さん{が|ga-subject}駅[えき]{の|no-possessive}ほう{へ/に|e-direction}手[て]{を|o-object}振[ふ]りました。
issues.problem: Non-focus subject slot: は is equally natural with no context forcing が, but was not listed.

issues.jp_before: 姉[あね]{は/が|wa-topic}弟[おとうと]{への|e-no}文句[もんく]{を|o-object}母[はは]{に|ni-recipient}話[はな]しました。
issues.problem: 文句を話す is an unnatural collocation; the normal verb is 文句を言う.
issues.action: Changed 話しました to 言いました.

issues.jp_before: 朝[あさ]{の|no-possessive}家族[かぞく]{への|e-no}あいさつ{は|wa-topic}大切[たいせつ]です。
issues.problem: 朝の家族 reads as 'the morning family'; the modifier order is awkward and ambiguous.
issues.action: Reordered to 家族への朝のあいさつは大切です and moved f from 1 to 0.

issues.jp_before: 工場[こうじょう]{の|no-possessive}作業服[さぎょうふく]{は/が|wa-topic}丈夫[じょうぶ]な綿[めん]{で|de-material}縫[ぬ]ってあります。
issues.problem: 綿で縫ってある suggests sewn with cotton thread rather than made of cotton cloth; unnatural for the intended meaning.
issues.action: Changed to 作られています; English and why updated to 'made from'.

issues.jp_before: 工作[こうさく]{の|no-possessive}授業[じゅぎょう]{で|de-place}、木[き]{と|to-and}釘[くぎ]{で|de-material}鳥[とり]{の|no-possessive}家[いえ]{を|o-object}組[く]み立[た]てました。
issues.problem: 鳥の家 is not the natural word for a birdhouse; the standard word is 巣箱.
issues.action: Replaced 鳥の家 with 巣箱[すばこ] (focus index unchanged).

issues.jp_before: 京都[きょうと]{の|no-possessive}お寺[てら]{は/が|wa-topic}一日[いちにち]{で|de-time-limit}全部[ぜんぶ]回[まわ]れません。
issues.problem: Distractor に is not plainly wrong: 一日に全部は回れない is acceptable Japanese with nearly the same meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor に with が (d: を, まで, が).
